T: The letters are out. The snacks are in.
D: A teenager's secret love letters are mailed out, and she starts a fake relationship to cover it up.
P: Serve the snacks when Peter brings Lara Jean a Korean yoghurt drink.
S: Frozen yoghurt and honey pops swirled with strawberry purée

Tangy yoghurt blended with milk, honey and lemon, swirled with strawberry purée and frozen into ice blocks, the yoghurt drink flavour on a stick. Blend 300g plain yoghurt with 200ml milk, 3 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp lemon juice until smooth and pourable. Blitz 150g strawberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar. Half fill 8 ice block moulds with the yoghurt, add a spoon of strawberry purée to each, then top up with yoghurt and swirl with a skewer. Insert sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours. Run the moulds under warm water to release.
Marshmallows dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed peppermint

Marshmallows dipped in melted dark chocolate, rolled in crushed peppermint lollies and set on baking paper. Melt 150g dark chocolate. Dip 20 marshmallows halfway and roll the chocolate end in crushed peppermint lollies. Set on baking paper for 20 minutes. Pack them for the school ski trip, especially the hot tub bit.
Lara Jean's little sister Kitty, who started it all

Freshly popped corn tossed in a sweet and salty Korean-style honey butter glaze, baked until crunchy and finished with flaky salt. Heat the oven to 150C. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a large covered pot over medium heat, shaking often, and tip into a big bowl. Melt 60g butter with 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp brown sugar and bubble for 1 minute. Pour over the popcorn, add half a tsp salt and toss well. Spread on lined trays and bake 10 minutes, stirring once. Cool, break up and sprinkle with flaky salt.
M: Soy, pear and garlic beef seared hot, jasmine rice, quick cucumber kimchi

Beef rump sliced thin and marinated in soy, pear, garlic and sesame, seared hot, served with rice and quick cucumber kimchi. Slice 600g beef rump thin and marinate in soy, grated pear, crushed garlic and sesame oil for an hour. Sear hot in batches. Serve with jasmine rice and cucumbers tossed with salt, chilli and a little vinegar as quick kimchi.
Lara Jean and Peter's fake relationship

Smashed beef patties with double cheddar, pickles, lettuce and a tangy burger sauce in toasted brioche buns, with crunchy shoestring fries. Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for the sauce. Bake 750g frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Heat a heavy pan very hot, smash the balls flat and cook 2 minutes, flip, add a slice of cheddar to each and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 brioche buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties each with lettuce and pickles.
W: Hatbox love letter choc chip cookies
Nutty brown butter cookies with dark and milk chocolate, flaky salt

Chewy cookies made with nutty browned butter, brown sugar and chunks of dark and milk chocolate, sprinkled with flaky salt while warm. Melt 170g butter in a saucepan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown. Cool 10 minutes. Whisk with 150g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 1 egg, 1 egg yolk and 2 tsp vanilla. Stir in 250g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb and half a tsp salt, then 200g chopped dark and milk chocolate. Chill 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 180C. Roll into 16 balls and bake 10 to 11 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt and cool on the tray.
K: Mashed sugared strawberries stirred into cold milk over ice
Mashed fresh strawberries and syrup at the bottom of the glass, topped with cold milk.
